content:
We have functional groups list. For amide formation, forward reaction breaks acyl chloride, forms amide. So search templates with broken "acyl chloride" and formed "amide".
<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates where the forward reaction breaks an acyl chloride and forms an amide, which corresponds to the reverse step of amide bond formation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
